purpose: Cost feasibility of an isolated lag-3 timing/CFO proposal primitive

statistic.fold: exact int64 dense b*conj(a), divided by per-cell support
statistic.projection: 512 point-sampled linearly interpolated cells, FP64 centering and normalization, FP32 FFT
statistic.correlation: IFFT(FFT(projected_visit) * conj(FFT(projected_lag3_template))) for peak selection; direct centered native-cell lag3 correlation for phase
statistic.peak_rule: circular local maximum score>left and score>=right
statistic.epoch_rule: start at nearbyint(projected_bin * nearbyint(rate_hz/750) / 512), then maximize normalized native correlation over integer offsets [-ceil(n/(2*512)),+ceil(n/(2*512))] with lower signed offset winning exact ties
statistic.phase_cfo_rule: arg(direct centered native-cell complex correlation) * rate_hz / (2*pi*3)

timing_gate.metric: median caller thread CPU ms for complete natural-stride ingress plus proposal
timing_gate.receiver_order: counterbalanced by case index and repetition

constructed_controls.role: proposal sign, support, ambiguity, and bias diagnostics; not detector outcomes

stop_rule: If either rate misses 0.080 ms, stop before detector replay or GLRT integration; do not tune the statistic.
qualification_limits: This is a new proposal statistic, not an exact optimization of blind acquisition.
A passing primitive cost does not establish a 0.260 ms detector.
Constructed pilot phase checks establish convention/sign only and do not establish unbiased CFO on real mixtures.
No holdout, RF, production, or ARM execution is permitted.
